title: Air Quality Testing, Certificates and Tenant Complaint Attendance under the Indoor Air Quality & Filtration Programs
content:
## Standard

Air quality testing under the Indoor Air Quality & Filtration Programs is carried out at the tier's number of visits per year, measuring the parameters the tier covers, and the report is delivered within the tier's report period counted in business days after the test on the office calendar, which excludes Saturdays, Sundays and the office holidays published for the year. Laboratory analysis is included only at the tiers that include it; elsewhere samples are sent at the owner's cost. Where a reading passes a published threshold, the company reports the exceedance, repeats the test at no charge once, and advises what mechanical work would address it, but it never certifies a building it has not tested at the tier that includes certification. The certificate, where the tier issues one, stands for the tier's certification period and lapses with the program. Tenant complaints are attended within the tier's response period, counted in business days from the day the complaint was reported, up to the tier's included investigations per year; investigations beyond that count are charged at the tier's labor rate.

## Counting rules

- **Report period.** Business days after the day of the test, on the office calendar; Saturdays, Sundays and the published office holidays are not counted. On hypothetical inputs and a week with no office holiday, a test carried out on a Wednesday under a 5-business-day report period has its report due on the following Wednesday; under a 10-business-day period, on the Wednesday after that.
- **Complaint response period.** Business days counted from the day the complaint was reported, on the same office calendar.
- **Included investigations.** The investigations counted against the tier's included number are those recorded on the program whose day of attendance falls in the current program year, from the first day of the term through the last day of the term, both days included. On hypothetical inputs, under a tier that includes 2 investigations a year, the third investigation attended in the same program year is charged at the tier's labor rate, and the first and second are not.

## Exceedance

| Reading against the published thresholds | Treatment |
|---|---|
| Passes a threshold | The exceedance is reported; the test is repeated once at no charge; the mechanical work that would address it is advised |

## Certification

A certificate is issued only under the tier that includes certification and only for a building the company has tested at that tier. Once issued it stands for the tier's certification period, and it lapses when the program ends, whatever period would otherwise remain.

## Laboratory analysis

| Tier includes laboratory analysis | Samples collected at a test |
|---|---|
| Yes | Analysed under the program |
| No | Sent at the owner's cost |
